## Description

This PR implements a feature to show a feed of posts from all groups a user has joined, addressing issue #362. The implementation includes a special approach to handle icon compatibility issues with lucide-react.

### Features Implemented

1. Created a new `/feed` route that shows posts from all groups the user is a member of
2. Implemented group posts feed with tabs for "Approved" and "All" posts
3. Created a group post item component that displays posts with their group context
4. Added navigation in the header for easy access to the feed
5. Added a custom Icon component to handle icon compatibility issues

### Technical Implementation

#### Feed Feature
- Posts are fetched group by group to avoid overwhelming relays with large queries
- Posts are properly filtered to exclude:
  - Removed posts
  - Posts from banned users
  - Posts that are replies rather than top-level posts
- The implementation respects the group approval system:
  - Has tabs for "Approved" vs "All" posts
  - Includes auto-approval logic for posts by approved members
- Posts are displayed in chronological order (newest first)
- Each post shows which group it belongs to with a direct link to view it in context

#### Icon Compatibility Fix
- Created a custom Icon component that wraps lucide-react icons
- Added fallback SVG implementations for icons that might not be available in the library
- Replaced direct icon imports with the custom component to prevent errors
- Implemented graceful fallbacks if icons are not found

### Why This Approach

The custom Icon component provides a robust solution to the compatibility issues with lucide-react icons:
1. Works regardless of which specific icons are available in any version of the library
2. Doesn't rely on importing specific icons directly
3. Provides suitable fallbacks even if icons are missing
4. Makes icon usage more maintainable across the app

### Testing Instructions

1. Log in to the application
2. Join multiple groups
3. Navigate to the "Feed" page using the header link
4. Toggle between "Approved" and "All" tabs
5. Click on group badges to visit the source group
6. Click "View in group" to see a post in full context

Closes #362

title: Normalize browser extension behavior, fix Cashu wallet error handling
body:
This fixes https://github.com/andotherstuff/chorus/issues/382

1. Alby incorrectly implements NIP-07. I upgraded Nostrify to wrap it in a compat class, and make it properly throw instead of returning data of the wrong type when failing to decrypt data. Now Alby and Nos2x will behave the same way, making it easier to support both extensions.

2. In the onboarding flow, users with an extension but without a wallet would get stuck. To fix it, we needed to be checking `!isFetching` instead of `!isLoading` to pass through the wallet creation screen.

3. I removed the `derivePrivkeyFromNostrSignature` function because it was creating dozens of unnecessary browser extension popups, increasing the load on an already buggy system. Now it uses `bytesToHex(generateSecretKey())`

4. I allowed the wallet query in `useCashuWallet` to throw, allowing React Query to properly handle errors.

## 🚀 Relay Crawler Implementation

This PR adds a Cloudflare Worker that automatically crawls Nostr relays every minute and stores events for the notification system.

### What's included:

#### Worker Code
- `worker/cloudflare-worker/src/relay-crawler-worker.ts` - The relay crawler worker
- `worker/cloudflare-worker/wrangler-crawler.toml` - Cloudflare configuration

#### GitHub Actions Workflows
- `.github/workflows/setup-relay-crawler.yml` - One-time setup to create KV namespaces
- `.github/workflows/deploy-relay-crawler.yml` - Auto-deploy on push to main

#### Features
- Runs every minute via Cloudflare Cron
- Crawls multiple relays in parallel
- Stores events in KV with 7-day TTL
- Health check endpoint at `/health`
- Statistics endpoint at `/stats`
- Optional authentication for manual triggers

### Setup Required After Merge

1. Add GitHub Secrets:
   - `CF_API_TOKEN`
   - `CF_ACCOUNT_ID`
   - `CF_ACCOUNT_SUBDOMAIN`

2. Run the setup workflow to create KV namespaces

3. Update `wrangler-crawler.toml` with the KV namespace IDs

4. Push to trigger deployment

### Testing
The worker includes health monitoring and statistics endpoints for verification after deployment.

title: feat: Add automatic profile sync on login
body:
## Summary

This PR adds automatic profile synchronization when users log in to ensure their kind 0 (profile) events are available on the primary relay.

## Problem

When users log in and their profile event isn't found on our primary relay (wss://relay.chorus.community/), their profile information won't be displayed properly to other users.

## Solution

- Created a `useProfileSync` hook that checks for the user's profile on the primary relay after login
- If not found, immediately queries fallback relays in order:
  - wss://purplepag.es
  - wss://relay.nos.social  
  - wss://cache2.primal.net/v1
- If found on any fallback, republishes the event exactly as-is to the primary relay
- Integrated into all login methods (extension, nsec, bunker)

## Implementation Details

1. **New Hook**: `useProfileSync` handles the profile synchronization logic
2. **Modified**: `useLoginActions` to return login objects containing the user's pubkey
3. **Updated**: `LoginDialog` to call profile sync immediately after successful authentication
4. **Logging**: All operations are logged for debugging but no UI is shown to users

## Testing

The implementation has been tested to compile successfully. The sync process runs silently in the background without interrupting the user experience.

## Changelog

- ✅ Updated CHANGELOG.md with the new feature

title: 🚀 PWA Push Notifications & PWABuilder Optimization (No Service Worker Caching)
body:
## Summary

This PR re-implements push notifications and PWA optimizations with a key focus on **no service worker caching** to ensure compatibility with PWABuilder.com requirements.

## Key Features

### 🔔 Push Notifications
- Web push notification support for group activities
- Notification click handling with smart navigation
- Background sync capabilities for future enhancements
- Push subscription management

### ⚡ PWA Optimization for PWABuilder.com
- **No service worker caching** - All requests pass through to network
- Comprehensive manifest.json with all required PWABuilder fields
- Full icon set (16x16 to 1024x1024) including maskable icons
- App screenshots for store listings
- App shortcuts for quick actions

### 📱 PWABuilder Ready
The service worker (`sw.js`) is specifically configured to:
```javascript
// Fetch event - pass through all requests to network
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  // Simply pass through all requests without caching
  event.respondWith(fetch(event.request));
});
```

This approach ensures:
- No resources are cached by the service worker
- Real-time data from Nostr relays
- Full compatibility with PWABuilder requirements
- Ready for app store package generation

## Technical Details

### Service Worker Features:
- ✅ No caching - all fetch requests pass to network
- ✅ Push notification handling
- ✅ Notification click navigation
- ✅ Background sync support
- ✅ Push subscription management

- ✅ All required fields for PWABuilder
- ✅ Comprehensive icon set with maskable versions
- ✅ App screenshots for store listings
- ✅ Shortcuts for quick actions
- ✅ Proper theme/background colors

## Summary

This PR simplifies the group creation process by reducing required fields and automating the group identifier generation.

## Changes

### 1. Auto-generate Group Identifier
- Removed the group identifier input field from the form
- Added  function that:
  - Converts group name to lowercase
  - Replaces non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens
  - Appends timestamp in base36 format for uniqueness
  - Example: "My Awesome Group" → "my-awesome-group-lz5q8k3"

### 2. Remove Image URL Field
- Simplified image upload to only allow file uploads
- Removed the URL input option
- Cleaner UI with single file upload input

### 3. Make Description Optional
- Description is no longer a required field
- Only group name is now required
- Description tag only added to Nostr event if provided
- Updated validation and error messages

## Benefits
- **Improved UX**: Users don't need to think about unique identifiers
- **Simplified form**: Only one required field (group name)
- **Cleaner interface**: Removed redundant image URL option
- **Flexibility**: Users can create groups quickly with just a name
